physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the thyroid, the small gland wrapped around the front of the throat, just under the place a person points to when they say I. It sits exactly where the voice comes out. That is not decoration. This is the code of how a self is shown, and the body has put its chemistry of selfhood at the place where breath becomes sound.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. Mediocrity is not only a held opinion, it is a held throat. A voice kept small, kept on key, kept inside the agreed range. Over time the gland that runs the body's tempo learns to run it quiet. The pace slows. Warmth thins. There is a tiredness that has nothing to do with sleep, the tiredness of carrying a self that was never quite worn in. The body knows the costume does not fit. It tells the truth by going flat.

The climb out is also bodily, and it begins lower than choice. Heat returns to the front of the neck. The voice finds a register it did not rehearse. Energy comes back not as effort but as tempo, the engine warming through. The gland that was throttled begins to keep time again. The code does not have to be argued. It only has to be unclenched at the throat, and the body remembers how to set its own pace.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to a single amino acid, Phenylalanine. The thyroid uses it as raw stock. It is the element the gland reaches for and shapes into the hormone that sets the body's pace. Voice and tempo are made out of the same letter.

Phenylalanine belongs to the small group the body cannot make for itself. It has to be brought in. Taken across the mouth from the world, broken down, and only then handed to the gland that will turn it into a rhythm.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the quiet shock of this card. The code of style, the code most people think of as personal expression, is built on an element the self did not invent. The way you sound, the pace you keep, the warmth in your voice, the body fashions all of it out of something received. The originality is real. It is just not self made. The fire of being unrepeatably you is fed from outside, taken in, and only then sung.
